about: Numbers that join the two games. VS units are Vampire Survivors world units (its camera shows about 2 x C_CamOrtho of them top to bottom); ROUNDS units are ROUNDS world units (its own screen is 40 tall). A fresh ROUNDS gun: 55 damage, 0.3 s between shots, 3 ammo, about 2 s reload. Each row becomes a constant in Tuning (src/Shared/Generated/Tuning.g.cs).

rows.why: the VS camera's half height shown as this many ROUNDS units: the ROUNDS blob is about 5% of the screen tall, like VS's own characters (ROUNDS's own screen is 20)
a fresh 55-damage bullet does 16.5, like VS's starting weapons (Magic Wand 10, Whip 10, Knife 6.5) a little stronger since one gun replaces six weapon slots
percent-of-health cards would one-shot bosses; a flat amount instead (scaled by damageScale downstream as in Roundhead)

a VS touch takes half its VS damage from Orange's and Blue's ROUNDS health (VS lands about 15 hits a second on a character in a horde of a hundred at 5 minutes, each enemy at its own pace); one ROUNDS gun clears a horde slower than VS's starting weapons
VS's own heals (Floor Chicken +30, a partner's) count in ROUNDS health as VS's hits do (x contactDamageScale)

every ROUNDS heal on Orange and Blue (regeneration such as Beetle's 5/s, lifesteal, healing fields, heal-on-block): ROUNDS's amount turned into VS damage (x damageScale) and then into their health like a VS hit (x contactDamageScale). ROUNDS heals are made for ROUNDS fights (55-damage bullets, a hit or two a second); at full size Beetle alone kept a guy at full health in a horde (0.3.0). Beetle now regenerates 0.75/s, about a maxed Pummarola

VS's hits on one seat within this long reach ROUNDS as one hit with their damage summed (ROUNDS's hit sounds, flashes and on-damage cards at a sane rate). None is dropped: 0.3.0 dropped all but the first, about 85% of a horde's hits

a ROUNDS jump seen from above is a hop over the horde this long at jump strength 1 (times the square root of the strength: Pogo's 0.5 about 0.42 s, a full Super Jump about 1 s); no VS hit lands while in the air
